name: start_calls
description: Call this only after the caller confirmed which listings to verify. BEFORE calling it, ask if there is anything else they want asked on those calls. After it returns, read the speak field aloud. listing_ids must be real ids from the last record_preferences shortlist (like L061), never Listing 2 or an address.

request_body_schema.description: Which shortlist listings to call, plus any extra questions for the listing agent.

properties.description: Pass {{session_id}} or the session_id from the last tool result. Never invent it.
Real listing ids from the shortlist, comma-separated, e.g. L061, L003. Not addresses.
Extra things the caller wants asked, comma-separated short phrases.
